text: {"name":"llcp_pdu_parse","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Decodes an incoming BLE LLCP PDU into a working descriptor, copying selected payload bytes and computing scaled timing values.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"pdu_data","a2":"pdu_length","a4":"parsed_fields","v4":"header_word","v5":"existing_header_flags","v7":"header_scale_shift","v8":"decoded_header_flags","v9":"payload_word","v12":"timing_byte","v14":"timing_word","v17":"scaled_timing_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Packed header flags assembled from the input header, receive metadata, and existing output flags."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Three-bit field extracted from header bits 7–9."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Boolean extracted from header bit 6."},{"offset":5,"meaning":"Five-bit field from header bits 10–14, used as a shift amount."},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Byte copied from PDU offset 10."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit value copied from PDU offsets 11–12."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Derived value from the byte at PDU offset 10, shifted according to a decoded header flag."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"16-bit value from PDU offsets 11–12 shifted by the field at output offset 5."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Four PDU bytes copied from offsets 2–5."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Four PDU bytes copied from offsets 6–9."},{"offset":41,"meaning":"Byte copied from PDU offset 13."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Scaled timing calculation using the derived value at offset 16 and global timing constants."}]}
